_comment: Cases for the Decide step of .github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml, run by
tests/test_dependabot_auto_merge.py: each `env` overrides the eligible baseline below, and the
step must produce `decision` (enable, skip or disarm; for a skip or a disarm, a reason containing
defaults to "false" and `update_type`, when given, is the effective type the step derived. Every
`skip "..."`, `disarm "..."` and `refuse "..."` in the script must be reached by at least one
case; the test derives those lists from the script, not from a number here.
The baseline title is a version bump, so fetch-metadata's UPDATE_TYPE is what counts there; the
requirement-update cases set a title of Dependabot's `Update <pkg> requirement from A to B` form.
HEAD_SHA and REVIEWER_REVIEW_COMMIT agree in the baseline: codna approved the current head.
